observations: Signals 0,18,16,1 show b0 plus the three available gradients nearest the absolute source x/y/z axes. All use the same 0..1.15 signal scale, covering the retained range without clipping.

source_terms.generator_provenance: Pinned generator thresholds a resized scikit-image Shepp-Logan phantom into five tensor types. Generator code was read, not executed; only its pure rotation helper was selected for a fixed control.

findings: One synthetic 128x128 phantom supplies 31 float32 signal volumes: one b0 and 30 directions at b=1000 s/mm^2. All 13 task sources, 60 shared sources and 13 released assets match their pinned identities. TLS/connection failures for two files were recovered through the official hf.co route; failed receipts remain retained.

The 31x7 design matrix has rank 7. The source uses [ln S0,Dxx,Dxy,Dxz,Dyy,Dyz,Dzz], with doubled off-diagonal gradient terms. OLS uses log signals floored at 1e-10; WLS uses squared OLS-predicted signals clipped to [1e-10,1e10] and falls back to OLS on a singular solve.

All eight retained helper fixtures replay within numerical precision. Five post-hoc selected native pixels, one per distinct truth tensor, reproduce saved OLS/WLS tensor entries within 1.16e-10 mm^2/s. These controls are not a new full-image or agent run.

Saved OLS/WLS FA and MD derive consistently from saved tensors within float32 precision. All 7186 masked tensors have positive eigenvalues in both saved methods. Source code clips negative eigenvalues for scalar derivation, but does not modify the fitted tensor or guarantee positive definiteness in other inputs.

Masked saved FA scores reproduce notebook values: OLS NCC 0.997834/NRMSE 0.061319; WLS NCC 0.998025/NRMSE 0.058487. Saved MD scores are separately retained. A small difference in this one synthetic case is not a population claim.

The custom helper checks only tissue-masked FA, prioritizing dti_ols.npz when both saved files exist. Correct FA alone, correct FA with zero MD/tensor fields, and correct FA with background set to 100 all give NCC 1 and NRMSE 0. Thus this score cannot establish complete tensor, MD, orientation or background correctness.

The local filesystem end-to-end dispatch uses the generic scorer. Same-shape FA and MD outputs both select fa_map alphabetically; a correct MD oracle receives NRMSE 0.612870 against FA. A tensor-shaped oracle selects tensor_elements and gets zero error. Full-grid WLS FA NRMSE 0.038734 differs from masked 0.058487 because background zeros enter the averaging.

The no-filesystem-workspace source branch requires ground_truth.npy and returns an error for this NPZ-only release before any runner command. This is a dispatch control, not a Docker execution. metrics.json is absent from the complete pinned code/asset listings; historical notebook boundaries 0.8982/0.0643 are not silently reinstated as live thresholds.

All L1-L3 seed the complete data directory, including FA, MD, tensor truth and tissue mask. Source/evaluation folders stay absent. Installer commands were intercepted and never executed. A reader reference reveal cannot establish a hidden-reference solver condition.

The pure source rotation maps the z basis vector to the declared axis, while its largest eigenvalue is attached to the first column. All four anisotropic stored tensor types have principal axes orthogonal to their declared source directions; all corresponding stored tensor values are verified exactly after float32 conversion. The 466 isotropic pixels have no unique principal axis. Original arrays and labels remain retained, with the discrepancy documented.

The notebook labels (45,64) as white matter and (64,64) as gray matter, but both contain the same FA 0.707107 tensor; its CSF point (64,50) is outside the tissue mask. The explanation will use verified row/column probes and tensor axes, not these unsupported labels or an anatomical affine.

Native signal views, the exact gradient/design matrix, bounded pixel fits, tensor-derived maps and scoring/staging controls can support an operation-specific story. Canonical authoring, fresh export and visual acceptance are still required; source audit alone does not complete this entry.
